Subject: Clarification on Bi-weekly Team Meetings

Dear Team,

I hope this email finds you well. As part of our ongoing efforts to streamline our operations, I would like to provide a clear overview of the process for scheduling and conducting our bi-weekly team meetings.

The bi-weekly meetings will be held every Thursday at 10 AM. These meetings are designed to keep our team aligned, facilitate open communication, and ensure everyone has the opportunity to contribute to ongoing projects and upcoming tasks. 

To schedule the meeting, please send an email to me with the agenda points you would like to cover. I will compile these and send out the meeting details, including the agenda, to the entire team approximately one day prior to the meeting.

If you have any questions or require further clarification on this process, please do not hesitate to reach out. Your feedback is valuable and will help us refine our practices to better suit everyone’s needs.

Thank you for your cooperation and dedication to our team’s success.

Best regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Contact Information]  
[Company Name] To: [Recipient's Email]
